test_title: SSC Selection Post 2025 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 30 Jul, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Fill in the blank with most appropriate collocation:
He always tries to ___ a good impression during interviews.
solution:
The correct answer is '**3**' i.e. **make**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**
__
 
• The verb **"make"** is the correct collocation when used with the phrase **"a good impression."**
 
• Collocations are specific combinations of words that are commonly used together in English, and "make a good impression" is a standard phrase.
 
• Options 1, 2, and 4 are incorrect because they do not form grammatically valid collocations with "a good impression."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.
 
**Complete Sentence:** *"He always tries to **make**__ a good impression during interviews."*
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "take"** is incorrect because "take a good impression" is not a valid collocation in English.
 
• **Option 2: "do"** is incorrect as "do a good impression" is not used in this context.
 
• **Option 4: "build"** is incorrect because "build a good impression" is not a commonly used phrase.
